page.title: User Management
page.subtitle: Manage system users, role assignments, security status, and account access.
page.retryHint: Reload the page to try again.

create.missingRequiredDirectory: Full Name, Username, Role, and a Reason are required.
create.missingRequiredLocal: Full Name, Username, Password, Role, and a Reason are required.
create.missingDirectoryUsername: A company username is required for company login.

fields.companyUsernameHelper: The user's name in the company directory
fields.emergencyHelperAdmin: A local sign-in kept for when the company directory is unavailable.
fields.emergencyHelperNonAdmin: Only available when the role is System Administrator.

rowActions.cannotChangeOwnRole: System Administrators cannot change their own role
rowActions.cannotDisableOwnAccount: System Administrators cannot disable their own account
rowActions.cannotRecoverOwnAccount: Cannot use admin recovery on own account
rowActions.enableFirstRecovery: Enable user first to perform recovery
rowActions.forcePasswordChange: Force Password Change at Next Login

editProfile.title: Edit Profile: {{username}}
editProfile.reasonRequired: A reason is required to change a user's profile.
editProfile.directoryRequired: A company username is required for company login.

roleChange.title: Change Role: {{username}}
roleChange.required: Selected Role and a Reason are required for role change.
roleChange.signatureMeaning: I am changing the role of {{username}} to {{roleName}}. Reason: {{reason}}

statusDialog.disableConfirm: Are you sure you want to disable account <user>{{fullName}} (<ltr>@{{username}}</ltr>)</user>?
statusDialog.enableConfirm: Are you sure you want to enable account <user>{{fullName}} (<ltr>@{{username}}</ltr>)</user>?
statusDialog.disableReasonRequired: A reason is required to disable a user account.
statusDialog.enableReasonRequired: A reason is required to enable a user account.

unlock.title: Unlock User Account
unlock.confirm: Unlock account for <user>{{fullName}} (<ltr>@{{username}}</ltr>)</user>? This will clear failed login attempts and reset account lock.
unlock.reasonRequired: A reason is required to unlock a user account.

emailReset.title: Initiate Email Password Reset
emailReset.info: The system will generate a secure reset token link and send it via email. Plaintext passwords are never generated or shown to administrators.
emailReset.reasonRequired: A reason is required to reset a user's password.

adminRecovery.title: Administrator-Assisted Password Recovery
adminRecovery.intro: Initiate administrator-assisted password recovery for user <user>{{fullName}} (<ltr>@{{username}}</ltr>)</user>.
adminRecovery.warning: This will generate a one-time 15-minute recovery code. The code will be displayed <bold>ONCE</bold> on this screen and must be communicated to the user via approved internal channels. Plaintext codes are never stored in the database.
adminRecovery.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. User forgot password and cannot access registered email.
adminRecovery.reasonRequired: A reason is required for admin-assisted password recovery.
adminRecovery.importantNote: <bold>IMPORTANT:</bold> This code will NOT be displayed again after closing this dialog. Ensure the code is transmitted securely to the user.

forcePassword.title: Force Password Change
forcePassword.confirm: Require <user>{{fullName}} (<ltr>@{{username}}</ltr>)</user> to change their password on next login?
forcePassword.reasonRequired: A reason is required to force a password change.

sessions.title: Sessions: {{username}}
sessions.revokeNote: Revoking ends refresh immediately. An access token already issued remains valid until it expires (see Security Policy: access token lifetime).
sessions.noTrustedDescription: Computers this user chooses to trust during sign-in will appear here.
sessions.revokeDeviceMessage: Next time {{username}} signs in from {{browser}} ({{ip}}), a 6-digit code will be required.

sections.title: Laboratory Sections: {{name}}
sections.loadError: Could not load laboratory sections or user memberships.
sections.intro: Assign laboratory sections to <user>{{fullName}} (<ltr>@{{username}}</ltr>)</user>. Selecting the entire department grants access to all of its current and future sections.
sections.empty: No laboratory sections are configured in the system.

relink.title: Re-link company account
relink.message: Re-linking <user>{{fullName}} (<ltr>@{{username}}</ltr>)</user> removes the current link to the company account. The user must be linked again before signing in with the company login.
relink.reasonPlaceholder: Why the link is being reset

resetMfa.title: Reset second factor
resetMfa.message: Resetting the second factor for <user>{{fullName}} (<ltr>@{{username}}</ltr>)</user> removes their authenticator app or hardware token, deletes all recovery codes, forgets all trusted computers, and signs out all active sessions. They will have to set up a new second factor at next sign-in with no fresh grace period.
resetMfa.reasonPlaceholder: Why the second factor is being reset
resetMfa.error: Could not reset the second factor.

hardwareToken.title: Assign hardware token
hardwareToken.intro: Assign a hardware token to <user>{{fullName}} (<ltr>@{{username}}</ltr>)</user>. At next sign-in the user will enter a code from the token to confirm it.
hardwareToken.timeStepHelper: Match the token specification (30 or 60 seconds).
hardwareToken.reasonPlaceholder: Why a hardware token is being assigned
hardwareToken.error: Could not assign the hardware token.

validation.hexEven: Hex seeds must have an even number of hexadecimal characters.
validation.base32Chars: Base32 seeds may contain letters A-Z and digits 2-7 only.
validation.stepInvalid: Time step must be 30 or 60 seconds.
validation.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for assigning this token.
